description: Boundary correction overlay for the final four undecoded bytes. instruction_replacements supersede incorrect export rows where raw-byte flow and surrounding semantics establish the real instruction boundary.

method.decoder: raw retail-byte flow verified with objdump/iced-x86, live Ghidra disassemble_bytes, and IDA/Ghidra semantic context
method.replacement_policy: old_rows are removed only inside the inclusive replacement span; replacement rows may consume bytes formerly split by the export. No Ghidra project mutation.

evidence: authenticated retail bytes decode linearly from 0x004014D0 as XOR ECX,ECX; MOV [EAX+0x896C],ECX; MOV [EAX+0x8970],ECX; INC [EAX+0x8990]; MOV EAX,1; RET
objdump -Mintel over the retail PE emits INC dword ptr [EAX+0x8990] at 0x004014DE and MOV EAX,1 at 0x004014E4
IDA source has sibling sub_4014F0 with the same field-reset/increment/return body using ECX; this block is the EAX-input sibling immediately after CC alignment
export rows at 0x004014E0/0x004014E1/0x004014E3 are semantically split tails of the INC displacement and MOV immediate; they are explicitly replaced
authenticated retail bytes and live Ghidra disassemble_bytes from 0x00438973 decode PUSH 0x46F7C8 (68 C8 F7 46 00)
the surrounding call sequence pushes 0x10, this, and 0 before the imported call at 0x0043897B; PUSH 0x46F7C8 is the missing second argument
IDA source labels the function at 0x00438974, but its ENTER 0x46F7,0 row starts on the immediate bytes of the preceding PUSH and is replaced
authenticated retail bytes decode as MOV EAX,dword ptr [ESP+0x1C] (8B 44 24 1C)
FUN_00464110 context stores FNSTCW word ptr [ESP+0x1C] at 0x00464154, then must reload that saved control word before bit masking; the replacement provides that reload
Ghidra/IDA export rows at 0x0046415A decode only the displacement tail 24 1C as AND AL,0x1C and are explicitly replaced
callers/xrefs into FUN_00464110 are present throughout 0x0046426F-0x0046490C, confirming this is active CRT floating-point code
The live code recovery overlay decoded byte 44 at 0x00464159 as INC ESP; this is also explicitly retired because it is the ModR/M byte of the restored MOV.
